metadata.physics_step_note: Engine ticks/time scale are execution acceleration; each observed RigidBody physics delta is checked against the fixed simulated step.
metadata.stw_definition: SOG; no current system is configured and the runner sets water current to zero
metadata.vmg_definition: horizontal world velocity projected onto the target course direction
metadata.wave_definition: WaveSampler remains enabled and is queried by the boat; local sampler amplitude is set to zero for static water
